visualCharacteristics.structure: large image (about 45%) | heading + text + link, vertically centred; stacks on mobile
visualCharacteristics.notes: Source section.shortVideoHeadline (Worldwide giving on /community, in a dark-grey section). Image fills its half edge to edge; colours come from the section style.

contentPattern: 1 row: [image (optional video link)] | [H2, paragraph(s), link]; cell order sets the image side
reuseGuidance: Use for a single large image beside a heading, text and link (source shortVideoHeadline). Not for article headers (columns-article-header), stock quotes (columns-stock-ticker) or repeating tiles (cards).
